questions.question: Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 5 × 4 + 12 - 3 ÷ 6 = 18

⇒ 1.25 - 6 = 18 (false)

5 + 4 × 12 - 3 ÷ 6 = 18

⇒ 5 + 48 - 0.5 = 18 (false)

On interchanging ÷ and -, we get:

5 × 4 + 12 ÷ 3 - 6 = 18

⇒ 20 + 4 - 6 = 18

⇒ 18 = 18

Hence, **we need to interchange ÷ and - to make the situation correct.**

• A quantity that has **magnitude and acts in a particular direction** is described as a **vector**.

__**Viruses responsible for several diseases are**__:

 
• Smallpox - variola virus
 
• Polio - poliomyelitis
 
• Rabies - Lyssavirus

questions.question: In which of the following countries was the first Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer, the first programmable general-purpose electronic digital computer, developed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__United States of America__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ENIAC, in full Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer**, the first programmable general-purpose electronic digital computer, built during **World War II** by **the United States**.
 
• American physicist John Mauchly, American engineer J. Presper Eckert, Jr., and their colleagues at the Moore School of Electrical Engineering at the University of Pennsylvania led a government-funded project to build an all-electronic computer.
 
• Under contract to the **army and under the direction of Herman Goldstine**, work began in **early 1943 on ENIAC.**
 
• The next year, mathematician John von Neumann began frequent consultations with the group. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Frontier **is the **fastest supercomputer** in the **World**.
 
• **The USA built the Frontier supercomputer**.
 
• **PARAM Siddhi – AI** is the** fastest supercomputer** in **India 120th in the world.**
 
• **Bhatkar** is India's first **supercomputer**.
 
• For a global context, the USA dominates with 150 supercomputers on the list, followed by China's 134, Germany's 36, and Japan's 33.

questions.question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution are Indian citizens guaranteed the right to six fundamental freedoms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 19__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The heart of Article 19 says:** "Everyone has the **right to freedom** of **opinion and expression**, this right includes **freedom to hold opinions** without interference and to seek, receive and **impart information and ideas** **through any media and regardless of frontiers**."
 
• **Right to Freedom** is a **Fundamental Right** which is described under **Article 19 to 22.**
 
• **Article 19 gives freedom to:**__
 __
 
• Right to speech
 
• Right to Press
 
• Right to Silence
 
• Right to Information
 
• Right to move anywhere and reside anywhere
 
• Right to form Association and Union
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Some important Borrowing of the Indian Constitution**__:

 
• **Fundamental Rights - USA**
 
• Fundamental Duties - Russia/USSR
 
• Election of President - Ireland
 
• **Concurrent list - Australia**
 
• Citizenship - Britain
 
• Republic - France
 
• Five year Plan - USSR/Russia
